title: SaP LISTMAP — User Guide
callout: This guide explains how to use SaP LISTMAP (Direktori Lembaran & Jenis Peta) — the web portal for browsing cartography datasets, selecting records, previewing a report, and exporting to Print / PDF / Excel.
p: SaP LISTMAP is a Data Selection & Export Center for cartography records. You can search four data categories, build a combined specification report, and export it for printing or sharing.

tr.td: Map sheet number, name, scale, release year
Digital Terrain Elevation Data files and levels

ul.li: Browser: Use Chrome, Edge, or Firefox (latest version recommended).
URL: Open the app address provided by your administrator (default local: http://127.0.0.1:5000).
Credentials: You need a username and password assigned by your admin (stored in server .env configuration).
Session: You stay signed in for 30 minutes of inactivity; after that you must sign in again.

ol.li: Open the application URL in your browser.
If not signed in, you are redirected to the SaP LISTMAP login page.

callout: If login fails, check caps lock and credentials. After several failed attempts, contact your administrator. Failed logins may be recorded in the audit log.
p: After login, the main screen has three areas:

tr.td: Report title, your username/role, theme toggle, Logout (and Audit for admins)
Category tabs, search, filters, data tables, row selection
Live report preview and export buttons (Clear, Print, Excel, Generate PDF)
Browse, select, export, view Audit log

p: Your role appears as a badge next to your username in the header.
h1: 6. Step-by-step: build and export a report
p: In the left panel, click one of the four tabs:

ul.li: Topography — map sheets with scale and release year
Land Used — land coverage classifications
DTED Elevation — elevation model files
Sjung — Sjung map sheets
Search box — type sheet number, name, category, or DTED path; results update automatically (debounced).
Topography: filter by Release Year dropdown.
DTED: filter by Level dropdown.
Rows per page: choose 8, 10, or 15 at the top of the left panel.
Use ◀ ▶ pagination buttons to move between pages.
Tick the checkbox on each row you want in the report, or click the row itself.
Click Select Page to select all rows on the current page for that category.
Repeat for other category tabs — selections are kept across tabs.
Selected rows stay saved in your browser session even if you refresh the page.

p: The right panel shows a live Document Preview (A4-style report):

ul.li: Report Title — edit in the header field (default: SaP LISTMAP DATA SPECIFICATION REPORT).
Ref — auto-generated reference (e.g. LM-2026-XXXX) when you first select records.
Date — today's date on the report header.
Sections appear for each category that has selected items.

p: If nothing is selected, the preview shows Your Document is Empty and export buttons are disabled.

tr.td: Remove all selections and reset the report reference
Open the browser print dialog (you can choose "Save as PDF" as the printer)
Download a formatted .xlsx workbook with all selected records
Download a PDF file generated in the browser from the preview

callout: Tip: Use Excel when you need editable tabular data; use Generate PDF or Print for a formal printable report layout.
